intro: There is no app, no network and no account, so most of the troubleshooting that dominates this category simply does not apply. What is left is mechanical: the drum, its triple safety system and the litter.

facts.text: App-free: no connectivity, subscriptions or account.
Safety comes from seven pairs of infrared sensors, a touch-sensitive pedal and a mechanical rotation limiter.
A built-in clumping delay lets litter set before the drum turns.
An 8 L bin, designed for bentonite and mineral-based clumping litter.

symptoms.title: The drum will not rotate
symptoms.summary: The drum stays still after a visit, or stops partway.
causes: The mechanical limiter has engaged because something blocks the drum.

fixes.detail: Remove a cup of litter and try again.
Pull the 8 L bin out fully and push it home.
With the power off, turn the drum by hand to find what the limiter is reacting to.

symptoms.escalate: A drum that will not turn by hand when empty has a mechanical fault; contact PetPivot.

symptoms.title: Cleaning interrupts itself repeatedly
symptoms.summary: A cycle starts and halts moments later, over and over, with no cat present.
causes: A dusty infrared pair reading a blockage that is not there.
The safety pedal held down by a mat edge or toy.

fixes.detail: Clean around the opening with a dry microfibre cloth.
Make sure nothing rests on the touch-sensitive pedal.

symptoms.escalate: If it still interrupts with clean sensors and a clear pedal, one sensor pair may have failed — a warranty matter.

symptoms.title: Waste smears on the drum wall
symptoms.summary: Clumps flatten against the wall instead of dropping into the bin.
causes: Litter that does not clump firmly.
The clumping delay has been shortened.

fixes.detail: PetPivot specifies bentonite and mineral-based clumping litter.
The delay exists precisely to stop smearing; leave it at its default.

symptoms.escalate: Smearing on a deep bed of firm litter with the delay intact is worth raising with PetPivot.
